name: causal_gap_promotion_v1

pinned_runtime_dispatch_audit.observed_program_order: update LRU miss map -> gather every missing expert tensor row into cache -> cache.kernel.apply
pinned_runtime_dispatch_audit.ordering_semantics: the pinned dynamic-LRU path does not split resident and missing experts into independent compute dispatches; required miss staging is issued before the expert kernel invocation on the native path
pinned_runtime_dispatch_audit.causal_interpretation: the measured host-ID-ready to quant_method.apply interval bounds pre-dispatch exact-ID lookahead; pinned source ordering places cold-expert miss staging on the blocking path inside that dispatch before expert computation

pagecache_substitution.reason: the future-aware Belady control is deliberately stronger than realizable Linux replacement for the same 7-GiB envelope while retaining finite measured cold-expert service on the pinned runtime's blocking miss-staging path before expert computation

claim_boundary: A supported causal H3 gate establishes a conditional-memory service-layer gap for the pinned host-driven runtime under the frozen 7-GiB conventional hierarchy campaign, including perfect PLE prefetch and a future-aware cache upper bound. The causal serialization claim is limited to the pinned dynamic-LRU native path in which missing expert rows are staged before the expert kernel invocation; it does not establish end-to-end speedup, energy superiority, FeRAM superiority, or a general impossibility of prediction, speculative expert prefetch, split resident/miss execution, GPUDirect Storage, or redesigned storage scheduling.
